question: In which year were the two most common causes of traffic accidents different from those in other years?
sql:
WITH top_causes AS (
    SELECT 
        c.db_year,
        pcf.pcf_violation_category,
        COUNT(*) as cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.db_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
    FROM collisions pcf
    JOIN case_ids c ON pcf.case_id = c.case_id
    WHERE pcf.pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL AND pcf.pcf_violation_category != ''
    GROUP BY c.db_year, pcf.pcf_violation_category
)
SELECT 
    db_year,
    pcf_violation_category,
    cnt
FROM top_causes
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY db_year, rn
